selected.primary_estimand: effect of a 90-min treadmill bout (AEX), MmSCs sorted from pooled hindlimb muscle 1 day later, vs sedentary on MmSC gene expression (WT C57BL/6J mice)

selected.paper_method: DESeq2 (median of ratios) + apeglm LFC shrinkage; DEG padj<0.05; volcano highlights |FC|>=2
selected.sample_inclusion: WT mice, sorted MmSCs, n=3 per arm; replicates with r<0.9 removed
selected.other_sub_series: CTX injury, Yoda1 culture, Piezo1 cKO, whole muscle, heart, liver: other estimands

paper_results.Fig.1c: volcano plot; no numeric DEG count in text or legend

decisions.reason: S2.1.p2; FIG7 (c); S4.7.p1: STAR + featureCounts; DESeq2 median-of-ratios; replicates with Pearson r<0.9 removed; genes with <10 reads within any condition removed; DESeq2 + apeglm shrinkage; DEGs = adjusted P<0.05.
